About Emil &

One guide. Fourteen years. Thousands of unforgettable journeys across the Pearl of the Indian Ocean.

The Guide Behind the Journey

Emil Jayasekara

Born and raised in Anuradhapura — Sri Lanka's ancient sacred capital — Emil Jayasekara grew up surrounded by 2,000-year-old dagobas, sacred bo trees, and a deep sense of the island's history. That connection to the land shaped everything. Long before he ever guided his first visitor, Sri Lanka was simply home. At 22, he traded a desk job for the open road and never looked back.

Over 14 years, Emil has guided over 3,000 visitors from more than 40 countries — families, honeymooners, wildlife photographers, solo adventurers, and everyone in between. His unique philosophy is simple: every person deserves to see Sri Lanka the way locals see it.

Today, Emil personally leads every single tour. No subcontractors, no third-party guides. When you book with Chauffeur Emillan Katour, you travel with Emil — the man who answered your first message, designed your itinerary, and genuinely cares that you leave with a full heart.

The Emillan Katour Difference

👤

Emil. Always Emil.

No pool guides. No reassignments. The guide who designs your tour is the guide who leads it. Every time.

🏎️

Premium Private Vehicles

Air-conditioned Toyota KDH or Land Cruiser for comfort across all road conditions. USB charging, refreshment cooler included.

🌍

Truly International Experience

Emil has guided guests from over 40 countries and understands how to serve different cultural preferences and travel styles.

📱

Always Reachable

Emil provides his direct WhatsApp for the duration of your trip. Any question, any time — he's there.

🎯

Zero Compromise on Quality

Every hotel, every restaurant, every experience is personally vetted. If Emil wouldn't send his own family there, he won't send you.

💚

Ethical & Sustainable

Community-supporting stops, responsible wildlife viewing standards, zero-plastic safari policy, and support for local artisans on every tour.
